DESCRIPTION_KR: Japanese-style grass pancakes is a traditional pastry originated from Japan. It is made from glutinous rice flour, rice flour and various herbal plants, such as mugwort, green tea or Perilla, etc. We choose natural pigments such as mugwort and spinach powder to add to the dough for coloring. On the basis of ensuring the appearance is beautiful and the ingredients are healthy, we add a touch of the fragrance of herbal plants to the Japanese-style grass pancakes . Mugwort contains a variety of vitamins and minerals, which can help enhance immunity and promote overall health. The cellulose in mugwort can promote intestinal peristalsis and aid digestion. Out of respect for the traditional Japanese-style grass pancakes , we use red beans as the filling. The red bean paste with a granular texture is sweet but not greasy. The aroma of green grass and the sweet taste of red bean paste combine to create a unique flavor, complementing and enhancing each other. In addition to the innovation in taste, there are also new attempts in the production methods. The traditional Japanese-style grass pancakes is usually steamed, but we use the pan-frying method, which makes the crust of the Japanese-style grass pancakes soft and glutinous with a hint of burnt aroma, and the filling more dense and smooth. The ready-to-eat product is suitable for the current situation of rapid consumption and meets the fast-paced lifestyle of modern people.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Churro, also known as Spanish fried dough sticks, is a classic Spanish/Portuguese snack. Its origin is said to be related to navigation. Sailors borrowed the method of making Chinese fried dough sticks and fried them in a simple batter of flour, which was convenient for making and storing on ships. The freshly fried churro has a golden and crispy skin. When you bite into it, you can hear a "clicking" sound. However, the inside is moist, soft, firm and chewy, creating a perfect contrast. Eating it while it's hot is the essence! The churro itself has a light sweet fragrance, mingled with the aroma of wheat and milk. In addition to being eaten alone, it can also be paired with cinnamon powdered sugar, chocolate sauce, ice cream, etc., adding a unique flavor. The combination of cold and hot flavors doubles the sweetness.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Matcha Warabi Mochi (わらび ち ち) is a traditional Japanese pastry made from the starch of fern roots. Its history can be traced back to the Heian period (794-1185), and it was once an exclusive food for the Japanese noble class. After the Edo period (1603-1868), with the development of starch extraction technology, Matcha Warabi Mochi gradually became popular among the common people and became a common summer snack for cooling off. The Matcha Warabi Mochi is soft, elastic and flexible, crystal clear and bright. It is smooth, sweet and fragrant with a rich tea aroma. Its flavor and texture are even better when refrigerated.

DESCRIPTION_KR: The history of Hanami skewered dango can be traced back to the Edo period in Japan, when they were initially served as portable snacks during the spring cherry blossom viewing event. In Japanese, "Hanami" means to enjoy flowers. To better align with this theme, on the basis of tradition, we used rice flour and glutinous rice flour as the main ingredients, and supplemented them with natural pigments such as cochininsect powder, mugwort, and spinach powder. We project the colors of spring cherry blossoms onto the Hanami skewered dango, making this dessert not only delicious but also visually like a work of art, full of the breath and romantic atmosphere of spring. Let customers feel the vitality of spring and the freshness of nature throughout the four seasons. Modern diners have an increasingly strong demand for diversity and personalization. Hanami skewered dango are very suitable for customers to modify and innovate according to their own tastes. At the same time, the characteristics of Hanami skewered dango, such as their sweet and refreshing taste and soft and glutinous texture, also lay the foundation for them not to overshadow the main feature. The feature of being easy to modify and innovate not only enriches the taste of the Hanami skewered dango but also provides diners with more choices.

DESCRIPTION_KR: The black truffle seaweed phoenix roll is generally long or cylindrical in shape, with the egg roll skin rolled into a flat or tightly packed cylindrical form. The outermost layer is dark green seaweed, which is thin and crispy, wrapping the middle egg roll layer that presents an attractive golden yellow. Black truffle, on the other hand, is dotted on the surface of the seaweed or inlaid between the egg roll and the seaweed in small granular or flaky forms, enhancing the richness of the texture. It forms a striking contrast with the colors of the seaweed and egg roll, making it extremely appealing both visually and taste-wise. It can be enjoyed as a casual snack during work breaks, study sessions, or gatherings with friends. It not only satisfies cravings but also helps relieve fatigue.

Finally, the size, shape and color of the finished product are consistent. The entrance of Pearl's Hill Auricularia auricula-judae is smooth, delicate, elastic, thick, nutritious, and strictly selected. It is the best product of Auricularia auricula-judae.

The mannan it contains has therapeutic effects on inhibiting tumors (especially ascites cancer), medical hemorrhoids and fistulas, enhancing energy, and preventing and treating cardiovascular diseases.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Huayao Brand Spicy Golden Soup， Select natural ingredients to restore the taste of the cafeteria.; Precise application of compound spices: Combine star anise, cinnamon, fennel, Chinese prickly ash, Sichuan pepper, galangal, tsaoko fruit, long pepper, fragrant amomum fruit, nutmeg, tsaoko fruit, dried ginger, angelica dahurica, white pepper, tangerine peel, as well as fragrant amomum and cloves, a total of 17 kinds. According to a unique spice ratio and extremely high precision requirements, use German low-temperature pulverization technology to grind the spices into 140-mesh fine powder. Different from traditional Hu spicy soup spices that can only be ground to 30 mesh, this directly determines the difference in the final flavor and core competitiveness. Boiling process: 1. Basic soup base: Different from traditional soup bases, we use the leg bones of Nanyang yellow cattle and the front leg bones of Zhoukou Huai goats as raw materials, and simmer them for 5 hours, implying the gathering of the five elements and the harmony of the five flavors. 2. Adding ingredients: Add selected ingredients such as small bowl fungus from Dongning, Heilongjiang, seven-core daylily from Huaiyang, handmade gluten made from Yihai Kerry flour, and Nanyang yellow beef. The ingredients are carefully selected from high-quality ingredients in the origin to ensure that each bowl of Hu spicy soup is mellow, rich, and nutritious. 3. Seasoning: During the entire boiling process, the heat and time need to be precisely controlled, and spices are added for core seasoning to ensure that the soup base is rich and thick, the meat ingredients are soft but not overcooked, and the side dishes are cooked to the right degree.; Usage method; 1. Take out the vegetable package and soak it in warm water for about 10 minutes in advance.; 2. Take 700g of water and heat it to 50 - 60°C (do not turn off the heat), then add the meat sauce package, gluten, fungus, and daylily and boil for 3 - 5 minutes.; 3. Take 100g of water and add the seasoning powder package and stir into a paste (with no lumps).; 4. Pour it evenly into the pot and stir well. After boiling, turn to low heat and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, then it can be served.

DESCRIPTION_KR: 清真芝士腸的特色主要在於其製作符合伊斯蘭教規，使用清真認證的肉類，並無豬肉及酒精等成分。此外，其口感通常豐富，有酥脆外皮和濃郁芝士內餡，同時也注重「健康」和「無添加」，例如部分產品會強調使用原塊肉材、無澱粉或減鹽。; 宗教符合性: 「清真」意指「合法的」，表示產品在從肉品來源、屠宰方式到加工、包裝、儲存等各個環節，都符合伊斯蘭教規。這意味著它只使用清真認證的肉類（如雞肉、牛肉），並嚴禁使用豬肉及其製品、血製品及含酒精的食品。; 風味與口感:; 芝士內餡: 腸內會加入芝士，增加香濃的風味與口感。; 外酥內嫩: 烹調後外皮酥脆，內部肉質鮮嫩，口感層次豐富。; 雞肉或牛肉: 由於使用雞肉或牛肉，相較於傳統的豬肉腸，通常脂肪含量較低，口感也更為細緻。; 用途: 可用於多種料理，例如燒烤、炒飯、三明治等，是適合全家食用的方便食品。

It tastes like "Nectar" taken from the trunk of the tree and put into a bottle. It is pure enough to taste the slight sweetness of the grass and trees, and it has more natural freshness than ordinary drinking water.; 2. DESCRIPTION_KR: Momoyama Town in Kinokawa City, Wakayama is known as “Peach Town” as the name itself represents. (Direct translation of the town’s name is “Peach Mountain Town”), and the best producer of peaches in western Japan. We use these high-quality peaches which are grown with lots of sunlight, so that the drink has a rich flavor and texture of the fruit. We cut the peaches by hand, puree them, and press them carefully in order not to damage the fragrance and flavor. In addition, this drink contains 60% natural peach juice, which is much higher than other general nectarine drinks of only about 30 %. So, the drink is very thick. You can enjoy the fruit’s texture as if eating the peach itself. It has a good sweet flavor with a clean aftertaste.

DESCRIPTION_KR: 全球生态文明长廊，北纬33度稻作腹地，在得天独厚的肥沃土地中，带来了一年一季的大地回礼。成立于2002年的大庭昌(江苏)粮油食品有限公司，立足于江苏省盱眙县，地处洪泽湖南岸，交通便利，土地肥沃，是物产丰富、美丽富饶的鱼米之乡，万亩良田充盈着苏北的粮仓。大地回礼作为其子公司，成立于2024年，以更先进的创新科技，更健康的饮食理念，打造全新生活方式。公司实行从选种、种植到收储、加工全产业链经营模式，2016年开展订单农业计划，积极落实优质水稻品种的培育和生产，从种子农药的选择到田间管理，形成了标准化的流程规范。履迹中国，曾荣获“江苏省农业产业化省级重点龙头企业”、“江苏大米核心企业”、“全国放心粮油示范工程”“江苏省省级粮食应急保障示范企业”、“江苏省粮油科技创新先进企业”、“厦门大学环境与生态学院低GI农产品校企成果示范基地”等多项荣誉。值得信任，更值得信赖。; 随着人们物质基础和健康意识的提升，传统大米的高升糖属性，让时代里的人们有了戒备。如何让糖尿病人群、孕期女性、减脂人群和儿童吃到更健康的米饭，如何让中国人吃到更低升糖的食物，成为了时代的命题。几千年来，主食迭代从未停止，但真正引领主食健康的代际级的工艺也从未出现。没有人走过的路，总要有人走成一条坦途。2010年，厦门大学成功研发出低GI大米种植技术，经过10余年工艺发展和技术迭新，实现自然生长的低升糖大米。大地的回礼品牌创始人姜松社先生凭借40年来的种植经验，成为首个独家大批量引入低GI种植工艺的粮食企业。春生夏长秋收，大地的回礼，为时代发展，为人们健康，在一代人的砥砺前行之中，呈现在中国的沃野之上。至此，一个中国低GI食品领导企业，由此而生。; 大地的回礼，以让中国人吃好饭，引领三代人的身体健康为己任，成就中国低GI自然健康主食领导品牌。那么什么是GI？血糖生成指数(GI)是糖尿病研究中发展起来的概念，用来衡量食物中的碳水化合物摄取后对血糖升高程度的一种指标，代表的是人体食用一定量的某种食物后会引起多大的血糖反应。主要用于指导糖尿病患者的合理饮食，对健康人群也有一定的参考意义。低GI食物在胃肠中停留时间长，吸收率低，葡萄糖进入血液后的峰值低、下降速度也慢，餐后血液中的血糖一直处于相对平稳状态，避免了餐后血糖的剧烈波动。长期食用低 GI 食品对降低糖尿病患者餐后血糖水平、减少胰岛素需求、改善饱腹感等都有着重要作用，尤为适合糖尿病或者糖前期人群、减重人群和运动健身人群。大地的回礼，509项农残未检出，0农残、0添加、0色素、0激素、0重金属，以软糯清香，饱满弹润，回口悠然等优势，成为控糖大米中的佼佼者。; 在微小处耕耘，用创新不断创造新的“价值”。大地的回礼，研发多种产品，满足中国人的餐桌。; 低GI慢糖米(细长型)/软糯淸香、饱满弹润、回口悠然。; 低GI慢糖米(滋润型)/轻磨多碾柔性抛光工艺。; 一家人的喜乐茶饭; 是大地给予时间的答案

DESCRIPTION_KR: JiTeSen No. 1 wine, carrying more than two hundred years of history, its story began in 1791, the fifty-sixth year of the Qianlong era. The founder Qi Yuting, with his son Qi Zisheng, broke into the East to Changchun, where he planned to set up a brewery, named “Chung Fahe”, and with the ancient technology of “two times to throw grain and nine times to steam, eight times to ferment and seven rounds to get the wine”, the brewed wine was strong and refreshing in the mouth with a strong aroma, which started the legend of brewing. This is the beginning of the brewing legend. As one of the eight famous wines in Jilin Province, it is not only a representative of the prestigious old enterprises in Northeast China, but also one of the key research units of Chinese wine culture, witnessing and participating in the rise and fall of the winemaking industry in Northeast China and its inheritance.; Raw materials, Jitsen No. 1 wine has a “right place, right time” - selected 44 ° north latitude, northeast of the black soil planted grain, in the nutrient content of the unique, and then by the Ussuri River, Heilongjiang, Songhua River, “three rivers” nourishment, from the source. "The three rivers of Ussuri, Heilongjiang and Songhua nourish the wine, which guarantees the mellow foundation of the wine's aroma from the source. And brewing water is taken from the “Chinese sacred mountain holy water” known as the Changbai mountain range water system, the original forest purification and volcanic rock, basalt dissolution filter, so that the water is rich in strontium, calcium, zinc, iron and so on dozens of minerals for the body of the wine injected with a unique spiritual charm.; In terms of craftsmanship, the centuries-old technique of JiTeSen One is even listed as an intangible cultural heritage of Jilin Province. From raw material crushing to finished wine filling, more than a hundred procedures are completed by hand, master and apprentice inheritance, teaching by example, and the production of cellar aroma, soft and sweet taste of the “secret”, is hidden in the centuries-old cellar mud that has survived the precipitation of the years.; JiTeSen No. 1 wine not only continues the “three good” concept of “good quality, good feelings, good brand”, but also renews its vigor in the new era. It has been used as the Imperial Wine of the Qing Dynasty and the wine used in the founding ceremony of New China, and now it is a good choice for business banquets to demonstrate taste, a generous gift for friends and relatives to convey deep feelings, a good companion for friends and acquaintances to get together to appreciate and talk about, and even because of its scarcity and cultural value, it has become a choice for many people to treasure and appreciate.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Linden honey  is produced in Raohe County, Shuangyashan City, Heilongjiang Province. The Northeast Black Bee (one of the four excellent bee species in the world) unique to Raohe County has strong cold resistance, and the collected oak honey has higher active ingredients. The honey liquid is light amber in color and easily crystallizes into a delicate and white oily state at low temperatures. Traditional Chinese medicine is commonly used to relieve fatigue and improve sleep.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Developed the first Alcohol-free beer (LA-01 yeast formula) with the sensory label analyzed by the E-tongue.; - Innovative ideas; “Let’s celebrate and to have a toast!”; Beer is indispensable in banquets, social gatherings and other occasions. However, alcohol is harmful to the liver and can cause various health problems. The birth of "Shake Shake Beer" is based on the hope that drinking beer can protect your liver the more you drink it!; -Brand name story; The non-alcoholic beer developed by HKFIT Hub and produced in Hong Kong is brewed from chrysanthemums. It is not only harmless to the liver, but also has the effect of clearing the liver and improving eyesight!; - Chrysanthemum health benefits; According to the Compendium of Materia Medica, chrysanthemum has the functions of nourishing the liver and improving eyesight, clearing the heart, tonifying the kidneys, strengthening the spleen and stomach, moistening the throat, promoting fluid production, and regulating blood lipids. Different from the common Saccharomyces cerevisiae, SafBrew™ LA-01 low-alcohol yeast can only ferment glucose, which usually only accounts for 10-15% of the total sugar in wort.
